jobs.title: Senior Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
IOA is on the forefront of revolutionary healthcare models, reshaping the way people can age in place. Our innovative models transform lives, enhance communities, and save healthcare systems millions of dollars. Rather than focusing on archaic outdated design, we strive to consistently question the “status\-quo” and create new and more innovative ways to help aging adults and adults with disabilities maintain their quality of life.


With over 23 programs, we offer multiple ways to aid seniors maintain their health, well\-being, independence and participation in the community, fulfilling our mission.


Urgently hiring.
  

This 100%onsite role, serves as the key administrative support team member to the Enrichment Center and supporting other Companioa Programs, this role requires a highly organized and proactive individual to ensure maximum efficiency and streamline operations in a highly dynamic team. Primary duties include supporting client referral to enrollment process, client records compliance, transportation management, supply management, and program coordination.**Prospects, Tours \& Enrollments**

* Maintain a thorough knowledge of all dementia services to communicate Companioa programs effectively and accurately to referral sources, prospects, and other visitors to the Enrichment Center.
* Receive all incoming calls to main line at the Enrichment Center \& provide response within 1 business day.
* Facilitate tours of the Enrichment Center for prospects and referral sources as needed and conduct timely follow up after tour to identify next steps.
* Proactively engage Director as enrollment barriers arise.
* Assist new client / family with Enrichment Center enrollment paperwork.
* Ensure all new clients have a successful transition to designated Companioa programs.
* Assist in completing \& submitting transit applications and supplemental documentation for all impacted new enrollees.

 **Client Records \& Billing Management**

* Maintain daily attendance log with updates, notes, and client\-specific needs.
* Enter client status updates (enrollment, disenrollment, hold, etc.) and notes for all communication with prospects and clients into electronic health record within 2 business days.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records for all funder \& grant contracts using required systems.
* Completely and accurately follow client file checklists to ensure files are complete, current, and in compliance with licensing.
* Manage client roster for Enrichment Center and Care Coaching programs. This includes, providing enrollment and disenrollment information in the client health record and submitting accurate attendance reports to billing department.
* Maintain emergency rosters for all enrolled clients with a minimum of monthly updates.
* Collaborate with program liaisons at Veterans Administration, SF Department of Disability and Aging Services, and other grant/funders as needed.

 **Transportation**

* Manage relationship and requests with outside transit providers, this includes assisting clients with Paratransit enrollment and coordinating requests for Group Van services, including participation in stakeholder meetings.
* Maintain transportation manifests for multiple providers.
* Document unmet and untimely service in internal logs \& communicate with vendors in real time.

 **Supply \& Vendor Management**

* Coordinate meal service with outside vendor to ensure accurate count of meals based on forecasted Enrichment Center attendance.
* Maintain adequate stock of program materials and supply and replenish proactively.

 **Other Duties**

* Participate in daily team meetings to inform Enrichment Center staff of the anticipated daily attendance and other details regarding prospects and other visitors.
* Assist Program Director in audit readiness and ongoing monitoring tasks to ensure compliance with state licensing regulations and other service contracts.
* Maintain knowledge of all safety and emergency protocols to effectively direct staff, clients, and visitors.
* Support Enrichment Center programs, including meals and activities, as needed.
* Actively participate in Companioa and IOA meetings.
* Other duties as assigned.

 **EDUCATION:**


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

 **BACKGROUND AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Five years of program or administrative experience
* Interest and ability to support older adults, particularly persons with dementia
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Ability to maintain effective relationships with a wide range of internal and external clients
* Team player
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Computer proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

 **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift 35 lbs
* Ability to reach, bend and walk

 **COMPENSATION:**

**Range:** $ 34 \- 35\.50/hourly

 *This amount is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of any specific pay for any specific employee, which is always dependent on actual experience, education and other factors.*

  

*This range does not include any additional equity, benefits, or other non\-monetary compensation which may be included.*

jobs.title: Bike Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**  

As a CBRE BikeProgram Coordinator, you will support the bike program in Mountain View andassist with the implementation of employee commute and transportation programs.
  
This position ispart of the Transportation team, which promotes alternative commuting optionsand helps reduce single\-occupancy vehicle usage through biking, walking,ridesharing, transit, and other mobility solutions.
  
This position isonsite five days per week.
  
**What You'll Do:** Rebalance campus bikes throughout the day to ensure availability across all buildings. Unlock all campus bikes in the morning and secure them at the end of the day. Recover campus bikes from offsite locations as needed. Assist with bike upkeep, including cleaning, replacing bike number decals, and identifying bikes that require servicing. Support the loaner bike program, including bike sizing, helmet fitting, and rider education. Assist with bike\-related events and classes, including Bike to Work Day, demo events, and educational sessions. Support the development and implementation of programs that encourage a biking culture across campus. Support tours, education sessions, and other transportation\-related activities. Follow all transportation, workplace, and safety procedures. Complete additional duties as assigned.
  
  

**What You'll Need:** High School Diploma or GED required. 1\-2 years of transportation\-related experience required. Prior bike shop experience preferred. Experience with bike sizing and basic bike fitting. General understanding of bicycle mechanics and functionality. Ability to identify bicycles in need of maintenance or repair. Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions. Valid driver's license required. Ability to lift up to 40 lbs. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills. Comfortable interacting with employees, visitors, and large groups. Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office products and Google Workspace. Strong organizational and time\-management abilities. Ability to multitask and work effectively under pressure. Strong problem\-solving skills and adaptability. Ability to work flexible schedules based on business needs. Ability to support operational activities when needed.
  
  

Why CBRE
  
When you joinCBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate servicesand investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problemsolvers and forward\-thinking professionals who create significant impact.
  
Our collaborativeculture is built on our shared values of respect, integrity, service, andexcellence. We value diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences andprovide opportunities for professional growth and development.
  
Our Values in Hiring
  
At CBRE, we arecommitted to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We valuediverse perspectives and experiences and welcome applications from allqualified candidates.
  
Applicant AI Use Disclosure
  
We value humaninteraction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills, andaspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiringdecisions, and we ask candidates to disclose any use of AI during theapplication and interview process.
  
Disclaimers
  
Applicants mustbe currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visasponsorship now or in the future.
  
  

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Bike Program Coordinator position is $60,000 annually and the maximum salary for the Bike Program Coordinator position is $60,000 annually. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience.
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We have a long\-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Customer Success Analyst
jobs.description:
Dealpath is looking for a self\-motivated Customer Success Analyst to join our growing team in San Francisco!



If you're interested in starting a career in Customer Success, this is a great place to start it. You'll help institutional real estate firms get the most out of Dealpath by building the configurations that shape how they run their deals. Your work frees up our CSMs to spend their time with customers.



The Customer Success team is supportive and collaborative, and they'll be with you as your career grows. You'll build the experience to move into roles like Customer Success Manager, and you'll have a real path to get there at Dealpath.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will****:**
---------------------------------------------------------------


* Build customer configurations from start to finish, picking up requests from CSMs in Asana and seeing each one through to a finished result
* Jump in on platform questions and support requests so customers can keep moving on their deals
* Develop deep product expertise and become the person customers and teammates turn to
* Work with CSMs, Product, and Engineering to spot patterns, then turn them into automation and new features

**We're excited that you have****:**
------------------------------------


* A puzzle\-solving streak: you like working out how to build something and breaking a big request into clear steps
* A product mindset: you enjoy learning new software and getting good at it
* Easy communication with technical and non\-technical colleagues
* Fresh ideas for serving customers and improving how the Customer Success team works
* Resourcefulness and a willingness to try new approaches to challenging problems

**Qualifications****:**
-----------------------


* Bachelor's degree or higher
* 0 to 2 years of professional experience. Internship experience in commercial real estate, SaaS, customer success, AI, or data is preferred, especially in a customer facing role
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the confidence to present to senior leaders
* Empathy for customers and a passion for helping them
* Demonstrated ability to work through ambiguity and solve problems
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets


**Nice to haves**:


* Familiarity with Zendesk, Asana, Salesforce, Jira, and SQL, plus hands\-on experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to work faster and smarter
* Interest in a long\-term career in Customer Success
* Prior internship experience supporting Customer Success or Go\-to\-Market teams

**The Perks \& Culture****:**
-----------------------------


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA) \& Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid Parental Leave
* Flexible Time Off (FTO) policy
* Commuter benefits program
* Monthly wellness reimbursement to support physical and mental well\-being
* Hybrid Work Policy
* Non\-Exempt: $85,000 Annually, with a 5k Bonus.
* This position is also eligible for Dealpath's equity plan.
* Your compensation will be based upon several factors including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and the skills assessed in Dealpath's interview process. Your actual compensation will be confirmed in writing at the time of offer.
* Dealpath's compensation ranges are determined by current market data, so compensation data posted on our job posts may change as new market data becomes available.

**About Dealpath****:**
-----------------------



Dealpath is the world's largest and most trusted AI\-powered operating system for real estate investing. To date, the platform has powered more than $10 trillion in transactions, partnering with hundreds of firms, including leading global institutions such as Blackstone, Nuveen, LaSalle, CBRE IM, MetLife, Newmark, New York Life, UBS, Manulife, DWS, and Principal.



By bringing together the only private exchange for institutional real estate listings, investment data, and intelligent execution workflows into a single platform, Dealpath enables firms to capture more opportunities, make faster decisions, execute efficiently, and deliver superior returns.



Our company is led by an experienced team and backed by a combination of top tier venture capital firms and strategic industry partners including Blackstone, Nasdaq, 8VC, JLL Spark, WTI, GreenSoil Investments, LeFrak, Milstein, Bechtel, and Morgan Stanley Expansion Capital.



We value your voice! If you get excited about solving real business challenges and working closely with other smart folks in a winning culture, we'd love to meet you.


**Interview Process Notice**
----------------------------



Dealpath conducts interviews via video conference. To support our interviewers with accurate note\-taking, we may use AI\-assisted transcription tools during your interview sessions. By participating in the interview process, you acknowledge that interviews may be recorded or transcribed using these tools for note\-taking purposes only. Transcripts are used solely for internal evaluation and are not shared outside of the hiring team.

jobs.title: Patient Access Manager (NORTHERN CA/NV/UT)
jobs.description:
**Patient Access Manager (PAM)**

**Position Summary:**

The Patient Access Manager is a field\-based single point of contact (SPOC) helping providers and patients navigate coverage, reimbursement, and support solutions so patients start and remain on therapy. The PAM is the primary contact for consented patients and caregivers across the GSK Oncology portfolio, guiding them through onboarding, access, and ongoing phases of the treatment journey, and supports provider accounts within the territory on coverage, coding, and payment questions after a prescribing decision has been made. The role is non\-promotional and provides one accountable contact across the GSK Oncology portfolio.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Patient Navigation \& Support:**

  

* Serve as the point of contact for patients, caregivers, and HCP office staff, providing approved information and education on oncology\-specific care, including benefit discussions, product and disease\-state per the PI,


* and program\-specific resources.


* Conduct welcome calls and ongoing journey touchpoints, speaking to the end\-to\-end patient experience within program specifics and using approved call guides, FAQs, and the Prescribing Information.


* Support patient enrolment in GSK services, including PAP, and guide patients and offices through enrolment requirements, missing information, and consent capture.


* Provide program\-specific treatment education via approved call guides, offering the ISI and PI whenever product education is delivered.


* Educate patients on coverage outcomes, cost\-sharing, and financial assistance options, including publicly available information on alternate coverage and independent foundations within program rules.


* Facilitate transfers to Specialty Pharmacy, Medical Information, the GSK Response Center, REMS vendors, and back\-office Benefits Specialists for BI/BV and PA tracking when appropriate.


* Conduct all patient communication through approved recorded telephony and program systems, verifying patient identifiers and consent status before each interaction.


Maintain accurate documentation of activities and interactions within GSK’s internal system.


* Capture and report adverse events and product quality complaints within required timeframes and follow crisis\-management procedures.


* Adhere to company policies and procedures, compliance guidance, and policies applicable to federal, state, and local regulations.


* Ensures activities align with HIPAA privacy requirements and internal compliance guidelines.

  

**Access \& Reimbursement:**

  

* Educate provider offices on payer coverage, coding, and payment policies for GSK Oncology products using approved materials and help offices understand and use GSK Patient Support Programs.


* Support access case resolution at the office level: explain benefit investigation outcomes, prior authorization requirements and processes, and appeal pathways, with the office initiating and submitting all payer forms.


* Identify access and reimbursement barriers and escalate complex, systemic, or technical payer issues to the specialist access function and to leadership.


* Interface with Payer Account Managers, Specialty Pharmacy Account Directors, and Oncology Sales teams within the boundaries of the PAN Standard and program ways of working.

  

**Operational \& Compliance:**

* Document all interactions and manage cases in Salesforce Health Cloud / CRM in line with program standards.


* Follow all SOPs and business rules consistently, and complete training on corporate policies governing access to confidential data on time.


* Maintain strict separation between patient\-facing and account\-facing activity: no patient\-identifiable information is shared with commercial teams, and the two sides of the role are never combined in a single engagement or documentation thread.


* Operate strictly within approved materials and compliance guardrails, maintaining the highest level of ethics and integrity.

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree.


* 3\+ years of experience combined in any of the following areas: field reimbursement, hub case management, patient experience programs, helping patients and providers navigate insurance verification, prior authorization requirements, and access criteria.


* Ability to travel up to 20%, including overnights.


* Valid driver's license.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Candidates should reside within the assigned territory or within 30 miles of the territory border.


* Extensive experience in oncology patient navigation, access and reimbursement, or hub case management.


* Advanced degree, such as an MBA, MPH, PharmD, or another relevant clinical or business degree.


* Active RN license and Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN).


* Experience using CRM and case\-management platforms, preferably Salesforce Health Cloud, to document interactions, manage cases, and maintain accurate records.


* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.

**Skills**

Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Market Access Strategies, Matrix Leadership, Payer Evidence, Pricing Strategies, Scientific Literacy

The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

The Operations Manager supports the smooth delivery of the organization's training programs and day\-to\-day operational functions. This role is responsible for coordinating logistics for public trainings, managing post\-training communications and data, supporting cross\-team reconciliation of program impact data, and handling essential office administrative tasks. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, organized, and comfortable working across multiple systems and teams.

* Reports To: Ceo/Leadership team
* Employment Type: \[Part\-Time / Non\-Exempt]

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Training Logistics \& Systems Administration

* Set up and manage Blackthorn registration pages for public trainings, ensuring accurate session details, pricing, capacity limits, and registration workflows.
* Create and distribute Zoom links for virtual trainings, including configuring meeting settings, waiting rooms, and registration integrations as needed.
* Track and monitor attendance in Blackthorn, ensuring records are accurate and up to date for reporting purposes.

Post\-Training Communications \& Feedback

* Manage post\-training survey distribution, including sending survey links, monitoring response rates, and compiling results for program staff.
* Draft and send post\-training email communications, including thank\-you notes, certificates, follow\-up resources, and evaluation requests.

Data \& Impact Reconciliation

* Support impact reconciliation into Salesforce, gathering and consolidating data submitted by both program and engagement teams to ensure accurate, unified reporting.
* Maintain data hygiene and flag discrepancies between source data and Salesforce records.

Administrative \& Office Support

* Retrieve daily mail and process incoming correspondence.
* Deposit checks received via mail in accordance with organizational financial procedures.
* Support the monitoring of the info@ email inbox, reviewing incoming messages and forwarding them to the appropriate staff member or department in a timely manner.
* Order supplies for public trainings and engagement events
* Coordinate logistics for public trainings (lease agreements, food and material printing orders, etc.)

Additional Duties

* Provide tech support for virtual trainings
* Provide general administrative support to the Leadership team as needed.
* Assist with preparation for board meetings through email notifications to board committee chairs and compiling of information for board agenda and slide decks.
* Attend cross\-team collaboration meetings and bi\-weekly staff meetings

**Qualifications**

Required

* 1–3 years of experience in an administrative, operations, or coordinator role.
* Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail.
* Experience working within multiple software platforms (Blackthorn, Salesforce, Zoom).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines and prioritize tasks independently.

Preferred

* Prior experience with Asana or other project management systems
* Experience with event or training registration systems.
* Familiarity with survey tools (e.g., SurveyMonkey, Google Forms, Qualtrics).

Core Competencies

* Attention to detail and accuracy in data entry
* Customer service orientation (internal and external stakeholders)
* Time management and multitasking
* Discretion when handling financial materials (e.g., checks) and confidential correspondence
* Team collaboration across departments

Work Environment

* Primarily Remote
* Does require weekly handling of physical mail and financial deposits, requiring regular on\-site presence in Oakland, California

**Compensation**

Compensation \& Benefits: This is a part\-time, non\-exempt position. Salary for this

position is $30 per hour/20 hours per week. Benefits include accrued vacation time,

separate accrued sick hours and 11 holidays per year.

**Applications**

Girls Leadership encourages individuals of all racial, ethnic and socioeconomic

backgrounds to apply for this position. Girls Leadership is an equal opportunity

employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race,

color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and

expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable

law.

To apply, please send a resume and a cover letter in Word or pdf format to

hiring@girlsleadership.org. The subject line of the email should include your full name

and “Operations Manager”.

Pay: $30\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor (Transportation) Fremont CA
jobs.description:
Hallcon is a leading mobility and infrastructure services company providing turnkey transportation solutions to clients across industries— including technology firms, manufacturers, railroads, universities, hospitals, airports, business parks, and public transit agencies.
  
Our services span commuter and campus shuttles, on\-demand and microtransit operations, integrated command centers, electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure, maintenance, analytics, and rider experience optimization.
  
We are currently seeking an experienced PM Operations Supervisor to support our expanding commuter and shuttle services across the Fremont, CA region.
  
  

The Role
  
The Operations Supervisor will oversee the day\-to\-day operations of commuter and shuttle programs, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient transportation services that exceed client expectations. This position requires strong leadership, problem\-solving, and communication skills, as well as familiarity with the transportation landscape and regulatory environment in the greater Boston area.
  
The ideal candidate will bring at least 3 years of operations or transportation management experience, with a focus on team leadership, safety compliance, and service performance.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
* Supervise daily driver activities and performance to ensure adherence to company policies, schedules, and client service standards.
* Serve as the primary on\-site liaison between drivers, dispatchers, and client representatives.
* Monitor route performance, address service interruptions, and take corrective action to maintain on\-time reliability and compliance with service level agreements (SLAs).
* Conduct driver audits, including pre\-trip inspections, safety checks, and documentation reviews.
* Respond promptly and professionally to client and rider inquiries, ensuring a positive customer experience.
* Prepare operational reports, safety summaries, and performance updates for management review.
* Support workforce planning, training, and onboarding of new drivers and support staff.
* Collaborate with maintenance and dispatch teams to ensure vehicle readiness and service continuity.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement across all operations.


Qualifications \& Experience
  
* Minimum 3 years of experience in transportation operations, fleet management, or dispatch supervision.
* Strong knowledge of the Fremont/San Jose, CA transportation region, including commuter and campus shuttle operations.
* Familiarity with FMCSA and DOT regulations and local transportation compliance standards.
* Experience working with fleet management systems, dispatching software, and route monitoring technology preferred.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with clients, employees, and riders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and standard reporting tools.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, as required.
* CDL Class B with Airbrake endorsement is desirable.
* Must be at least 21 years of age and authorized to work in the United States.


Why Join Hallcon
  
* Opportunity to support innovative transportation programs for high\-profile clients in the Boston region.
* Collaborative, energetic, and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Competitive compensation with medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off benefits.
* Career development and advancement opportunities within a growing organization.

* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement across all operations.

* Minimum 3 years of experience in transportation operations, fleet management, or dispatch supervision.
* Strong knowledge of the Fremont/San Jose, CA transportation region, including commuter and campus shuttle operations.
* Familiarity with FMCSA and DOT regulations and local transportation compliance standards.
* Experience working with fleet management systems, dispatching software, and route monitoring technology preferred.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with clients, employees, and riders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and standard reporting tools.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays, as required.
* CDL Class B with Airbrake endorsement is desirable.
* Must be at least 21 years of age and authorized to work in the United States.


Why Join Hallcon
  
* Opportunity to support innovative transportation programs for high\-profile clients in the Boston region.
* Collaborative, energetic, and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Competitive compensation with medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off benefits.
* Career development and advancement opportunities within a growing organization.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
With a network of nearly 200 branches, Loomis armored transportation, cash management centers, and cash inventory vaults keep cash flowing throughout financial institutions and retail businesses across the US. Loomis prides itself on providing employees with opportunities for career advancement and job satisfaction. In fact, many of our company’s managers, vice presidents, and corporate executives started out in the branches as driver/guards and tellers. Our work can be challenging, but the thousands who have stayed with our company for decades will tell you that if you have the desire to learn and the drive to succeed, Loomis is the place to be. Come join our team!
  
  

* Salary commensurate upon skill set, experience, and competency in operational leadership roles. Bonus eligible up to 25% annually\*


The Operations Manager will be responsible for implementing and administering Loomis policies and procedures as well as monitoring and controlling daily operations and assisting with long\-term operation of armored car routes and the cash vault. The Operations Manager will work alongside Management to develop, maintain, and supervise a professional employee\-centered culture, a safe and secure operation, a high level of service delivery, and cost effective and productive operations. This includes operational responsibility for all route operations (armored and ATM), vault and facility security operations as directed by the Branch Manager.
  
  

**Duties:**  

* Recruiting, interviewing, testing, selecting, and training of operations personnel. Training, development, and performance evaluation of operations supervisors.
* Oversight and coordination of route, dispatch, vault, and terminal operations through respective managers/supervisors.
* Oversight and coordination of maintenance of vehicles, forklifts, and other equipment. See that preventive maintenance and repairs are performed in a timely manner.
* Controlling the costs of operations.
* Safety of employees, vehicles, and facilities through training, monitoring, and enforcement of policies and procedures.
* Security of cargo and terminal through training, monitoring, and enforcement of policies and procedures.
* Investigating accidents and processing required paperwork.
* Developing and maintaining customer service capabilities among all operations staff. Responding to customer inquiries and/or complaints.
* Control overtime hours, monitor employee vacation schedules and maintain effectiveness and efficiency of route, terminal, and vault operations.
* Short and long\-range operational planning to meet branch goals.
* Delivers employee training to licensed armed driver/guards and terminal employees who operate or support armored transportation routes.
* Oversee the highly sensitive environment relating to ATM machines and the security required for all safety aspects
* Establishes and maintains cooperative relationships with local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies throughout the area and surrounding cities.
* Maintains company compliance with regulatory statutes involving DOT, OSHA, and EPA.
* Should have basic knowledge of Transit Vault, coin vault and CMS


**Qualifications:**  

* 3\-5 Years of Leadership Experience a plus
* Logistics or transportation experience required
* College Education or Military experience is Preferred
* 1\-2 Years of Safety and Security Experience a plus


**Essential Duties/Job Qualifications:**  

As part of the qualification process for the Operations Manager position, a Human Performance Evaluation (HPE) is required. This evaluation requires successful completion of testing in the following areas:
  
  

**Lift:**  

* 25lbs vertical lift from 10 inches to 66 inches from the floor (1X)


**Lift\-Carry:**  

* 18lbs vertical lift from 1 inch to 44 inches from the floor, and horizontally transfer 15ft (4X)
* 18lbs vertical lift from 10 inches to 36 inches from the floor and horizontally transfer 300ft (1X)
* 50lbs vertical lift from 10 inches to 36 inches from the floor and horizontally transfer 2ft (2X)


**Push\-Pull:**  

* Horizontally transfer 47lbs of force on a sled (single, non\-dominant arm), a distance of 1ft (2X)


**Repetitive Coupling:**  

* Squeeze Jamar Hand Dynamometer requiring forces up to 30lbs / both right \& left hands (4X)


**Climb:**  

* Ascend / Descend a step with heights of 16\. 21 \& 24 inches from the floor (10X)


**Benefits:**  

Loomis offers one of the most comprehensive employees benefit packages in the industry, which includes:
  
* Vacation and Sick Time (PTO) as well as Paid Holidays
* Health \& Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Plan
* Basic Life Insurance Plan
* Voluntary Life Insurance Plan
* Flexible Spending and Health Savings Account
* Dependent Care Account
* Industry leading Training and Development


Loomis is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, New Verticals - Grocery Merchant Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



Our New Verticals team launched in 2020 with the purpose of delighting our customers and empowering local communities outside of just restaurants. Since then, we've launched Grocery, Convenience, Alcohol, Retail, and DashMarts while also building merchant services, dasher tooling and consumer products. New Verticals is the growth engine of DoorDash's business and we are continuing to build and scale new businesses everyday! Grocery is one of our highest priority, most complex verticals that is key to acquiring consumers to new verticals outside of just restaurants.


**About the Role**
------------------



We are hiring two Associate Manager roles on our Grocery Merchant Strategy \& Operations teams to lead high growth segments of the grocery business \- mid market and local grocery. In this role you will serve as the general manager of your respective segment – the central owner of the end to end merchant and customer experience to make them successful. Your role will include a mix of managing the day to day success of the segment, while also driving long\-range strategic bets that are critical to the portfolio's success. You will partner closely with product, engineering, finance, analytics and sales / business development to bring these initiatives to life!



These roles sit at the intersection of strategy, operations, and product. The best operators today are rapidly generating new ideas, taking ownership over metrics and moving them in the right direction through building product visions, synthesizing complex analyses and testing every idea — all while leveraging AI to uplevel how we operate. We expect you to stay at the forefront of how AI is reshaping the work, actively exploring new tools, automating repetitive workflows, and finding ways to do in hours what used to take weeks.

* **Build with AI**. You'll use AI tools to automate manual processes, build new prototypes and develop product visions. You'll be expected to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI in your day\-to\-day work, and share what you learn with the team.

jobs.title: Associate Manager Product Operations, Autonomy Commercialization - DoorDash Dot
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------



DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last\-mile logistics in the long term. If you want to work on commercializing autonomy and robotics in a service used by millions of people — and on bringing the merchant partners who power that service along with us — then we want to talk to you!


**About the Role**
------------------



Come help us redefine last\-mile logistics through robotics, automation, and other advanced technologies. Autonomy only works when merchants — restaurants, retailers, and other partners — can reliably interact with our robots: handing off orders, troubleshooting edge cases, and trusting the experience enough to keep using it. This role owns that side of the equation.



We're looking for a Merchant Success \& Growth lead to build the strategy and operational mechanisms that get merchants onboard, keep them performing, and turn their day\-to\-day reality into a tight feedback loop for product and engineering.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


* Own merchant adoption and performance KPIs for autonomy end\-to\-end — defining what "successful merchant interaction with a robot" means, instrumenting it, and driving improvement against it.
* Build the playbooks and operational mechanisms to onboard merchants to autonomy — from first conversation through training, go\-live, and steady\-state ops — and scale them across markets.
* Partner with sales, account management, and field ops to recruit and ramp the right merchant cohorts for each stage of the product, and design experiments that test new merchant\-facing features and handoff models.
* Define merchant performance benchmarks (handoff success rate, dwell time, dasher/robot interaction quality, merchant CSAT) and run the cadence that holds partners and internal teams accountable to them.
* Stand up the feedback loop from the field back to product and engineering — turning merchant complaints, edge cases, and frontline observations into prioritized inputs that change what we build next.
* Be the voice of the merchant inside Labs: advocating for their constraints in product reviews, roadmap planning, and launch decisions.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You have a Bachelor's degree in business, operations, or a related field, or equivalent related experience.
* You have 3–6 years of experience in Strategy \& Operations, Merchant/Partner Success, Product Operations, Business Strategy, or a closely related field — ideally with time spent owning a partner\-facing KPI end\-to\-end.
* You've built operational mechanisms from scratch — onboarding flows, performance reviews, escalation paths, feedback loops — not just run mechanisms someone else designed.
* You're comfortable in the field. You'll spend time with merchants and on\-the\-ground ops teams, and you treat that as a feature, not a bug.
* You think in metrics. You can define a KPI, instrument it, and tell the difference between a real signal and noise.
* You communicate clearly across audiences — translating frontline merchant pain into crisp product asks, and translating product/engineering tradeoffs back into language merchants and field teams understand.
* You're biased toward action in ambiguous, early\-stage environments. You're energized by problems that don't yet have an owner or a process.
* Bonus: experience launching new technology, hardware, or operationally complex products with external partners.

**About DoorDash**
------------------



At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  

  

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.


**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------



We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.



Statement of Non\-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non\-binary or gender non\-conforming, LGBTQIA\+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently\-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you

jobs.title: Operations Manager - Sonesta ES Suites SFO Oyster Point Waterfront
jobs.description:

At **Sonesta ES Suites SFO Oyster Point Waterfront**, we are committed to delivering exceptional guest experiences through outstanding service, operational excellence, and a culture of hospitality. We are seeking an experience and motived Operational Manager to oversee our Housekeeping and Maintenance operations while supporting the General Manager in driving overall hotel performance.


This leadership position is responsible for ensuring the hotel's physical condition, cleanliness, safety, and operational readiness. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on leader who thrives in a fast\-paced hospitality environment and is passionate about team development, asset protection, and operational efficiency.

**Position Summary**


The operational Manager oversees the daily operations of the Housekeeping and Maintenance departments, ensuring the hotel maintains the highest standards of cleanliness, safety, and functionality, This role is responsible for protecting hotel assets through preventive maintenance, leading high performing teams, and supporting guest satisfaction initiatives.


The Operations Manager champions WS Management's commitment to Outrageous Hospitality, core values, and the three P Philosophy:

**People:** Support and develop team members through effective leadership and coaching.

**Planet:** Promote sustainable and efficient operational practices

**Profit:** Protect hotel assets and optimize labor and operational expenses.


This position serves as a Manager\-On\-Duty and may act as the General Manager's representative when necessary.

**Key responsibilities**

**Housekeeping LeadershipQuality Assurance**

Oversee daily housekeeping operations, room readiness, inspections, and cleaning standards.


Ensure all guest rooms, public areas, and back\-of\-house spaces meet or exceed brand standards


Manage scheduling staffing levels, training, coaching, and performance management for Housekeeping team members.


Partner closely with Front Desk leadership to ensure room status accuracy and efficient room turnover.


Conduct regular quality inspections and implement corrective action plans when necessary.

**MaintenanceAsset Management**


Lead preventative maintenance programs and ensure timely completion of work orders.


Maintain building systems including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and life\-safety equipment


Perform regular property inspections to identify maintenance, safety, and appearance concerns.


Coordinate vender services, repairs, and approval capital improvement projects


Protect hotel assets through proactive maintenance and repair planning

**Safety, ComplianceRisk Management**


Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, company policies, and fire\-life\-safety standards


Oversee proper chemical handling, MSDS compliance, and equipment safety procedures,


Maintain accurate inspection records, logs, and compliance documentation


Respond professionally and effectively to emergencies and operational incidents


Promote a culture of workplace safety and accountability

**Qualifications**


Minimum 3 years of hotel operations, housekeeping, maintenance, or facilities management leadership experience


Proven experience leading and developing teams in a hospitality environment


Strong understanding of hotel operations, cleanliness standards, and preventative maintenance programs.


Working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and general building systems


Experience managing labor costs, departmental budgets, and inventory controls


Strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills


Proficiency with hotel property management systems and Microsoft Office applications


Ability to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.


This statement listed are intended to represent the key duties and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be all responsibilities or qualifications of the job. Due to the cyclical nature of the hospitality industry, employees may be required to work varying schedules to reflect the business needs of the hotel. We are an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and make employment decisions without regard to age, race, religion, national origin, gender, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or other protected class. Those who are ineligible to work in the United States will not be considered.

jobs.title: Manager, People Operations
jobs.description:
Manager, People Operations


The Landline Company (landlineco.com) is revolutionizing air travel by bridging the gap between regional communities and major airline hubs. We partner with top airlines like American, Air Canada, Delta, and Jet Blue to offer innovative multimodal connections across North America. We’ve launched a first of its kind remote terminal checkpoint to expand the reach of major metro airports into local neighborhood checkpoints. Our luxury motorcoaches replace short flights with a faster, more sustainable alternative—reducing costs, addressing pilot shortages, and enhancing passenger journeys.


Job Type: Full\-time, Exempt


Salary: 86,000 – 91,000


The Role:  

We are looking for a Manager, People Operations to be a driver of our People Operations function across the U.S. and Canada. Reporting to the Director of People Operations, you’ll personally handle employee relations, investigations, promotions, corrective actions, new market launches, separations, leaves, and legal compliance, while keeping payroll, benefits, and employee records accurate and up to date. This is an individual contributor and people leader who loves being close to the work, takes pride in getting the details right, and wants to help bring our People strategy to life.


What You'll Do:

* Work closely with the Director and SVP of People to carry out company priorities, flag trends and risks, and recommend improvements to policies and processes based on what you see day to day.
* Serve as a key point of contact for employee relations matters, handling concerns and conducting thorough, impartial workplace investigations from intake through resolution, and escalating complex matters to the Director as needed.
* Partner with front line station leadership and business support team managers on performance issues, promotions, corrective action, and performance management.
* Manage the full separation process from termination conversations, severance memos (preparation, distribution, and filing), and system updates.
* Administer leaves of absence and FMLA, and manage workers’ compensation claims in the U.S. and Canada.
* Handle day\-to\-day compliance work, including I\-9s, responding to unemployment claims and letters, and processing child support and wage garnishment orders using tools like ADP SmartCompliance and E\-Verify.
* Function as an owner of our HRIS ADP WorkforceNow and process pay adjustments (pay differentials, bonuses, missing hours, pto, etc.) and troubleshoot ADP issues alongside our ADP \& Payroll Administrator.
* Process system and benefit enrollments, edits, and terminations, answer employee benefits questions.
* Prepare internal promotions, employment verifications, transfers, and cover employee onboarding as our backup.
* Maintain accurate, confidential employee records, including saving signed Adobe documents and thoroughly documenting employee relations events and actions in employee files.
* Support employee engagement initiatives remotely and in person and help carry out programs that strengthen culture and retention across a distributed workforce based in ON, QC, CA, IL, IN, MA, CO, PA, NJ, DE, NY, and more.
* Serve as a system administrator for People Operations requests and manage employee programs such as uniforms, training, travel, etc.
* Manage and develop our People Operations Coordinator associate.
* Support existing safety plans for our stations and teams in partnership with Operations.


What We’re Looking For:

* 7\+ years of progressive experience in human resources or people operations, including at least 3 years focused on employee relations, investigations, and compliance in a frontline non\-exempt environment
* Experience in people management with a hands\-on, execution\-focused approach and the organization to manage a high volume of work and competing deadlines
* Strong working knowledge of U.S. employment law (FMLA, I\-9, workers’ compensation, unemployment); experience with Canadian and Québec requirements (including CNESST) strongly preferred
* Proven experience conducting workplace investigations and leading difficult conversations, including corrective actions, terminations, and layoffs
* Preferred experience with ADP WorkforceNow, Adobe, Microsoft, Slack, and Zendesk
* Excellent judgment and discretion when handling sensitive and confidential matters
* Experience supporting a multi\-state or multi\-country hourly/frontline workforce, ideally in transportation, aviation, or hospitality
* French language proficiency and PHR/SPHR or SHRM\-CP/SCP certification a plus


Perks \& Benefits:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Paid time off
* Flight benefits through our airline partners
* Company\-paid life insurance


Location:  

Remote, with up to 30% travel to station locations in the USA / Canada with a preference for candidates based in San Francisco, CA, Boston, MA, Philadelphia, PA, Chicago, IL, NYC, NY, Denver, CO.


Schedule:  

Standard business hours local time Monday – Friday  

  

The Landline Company is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.description:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program or project management.
* 5 years of experience in a leadership role.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 15 years of experience in program management, business operations, or business process engineering.
* Experience in data analysis, utilizing metrics to track business performance and drive strategic decision\-making.
* Experience in stakeholder management and developing communication strategies across cross\-functional teams.
* Experience translating complex commercial datasets into strategic frameworks and actionable recommendations.
* Experience managing commercial operations, cost benchmarking, or deal governance for large\-scale infrastructure, corporate real estate, or capital projects.
* Experience leading change management initiatives, including the global deployment and adoption of enterprise asset management or operational tools.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Global Infrastructure and Energy organization is responsible to deliver the infrastructure to host and connect every machine and every user on the internet, with Carbon Free Energy (CFE). As part of the Commercial \& Business Operations arm within the Global Operations for Assets and Tooling team, we are responsible to help leadership run the business, and support the strategic negotiators land deals quickly and be able to maximize our returns.


As a Commercial and Business Operations Manager, you will lead critical initiatives that streamline our business operations and drive commercial success. You will act as a strategic partner to business leaders, identifying areas for operational improvement, designing scalable solutions, and leading cross\-functional teams to execute them. This role requires a unique blend of strategic thinking, analytical excellence, and strong program management skills to navigate complex business challenges.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $188000 \- $274000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and maintain operational dashboards. Analyze complex data sets to uncover commercial trends, track performance against targets, and provide actionable recommendations to executive stakeholders.
* Identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies in current commercial workflows. Design, implement, and scale standardized processes that improve productivity, reduce risk, and accelerate deal velocity.
* Drive alignment across various teams to ensure seamless execution of commercial initiatives. Manage complex programs from inception to delivery.
* Lead the rollout of new tools, systems, and operational frameworks. Ensure comprehensive training and high adoption rates across global teams.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. jobs.title: Supply Chain Operations Manager, LV Electronics
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**
We are looking for a Supply Chain Operations Manager within Low Voltage Electronics team to drive cutting edge technologies across all our vehicles and deliver results in a highly innovative and fast paced environment. This position will focus on mapping all component material flows globally for each active project working with external vendors and internal partners, develop robust material pipelining strategies across multiple products and vendors to mitigate E\&O and ensure supply availability. In addition, the person may lead Cost and Capex tracking across all components, programs and vendors within the value chain. jobs.title: Creative Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------


Must be based in the United States.


**About Nen Creative**
----------------------


Nen Creative partners with tech startups to launch bold ideas into the world, creating the brands and stories that fuel their growth.


Since 2022, we've partnered with some of the world's top founders and institutions, including Amazon, Andreessen Horowitz, Cursor, Mercor, Listen Labs, Tech Week, Cartesia, and many more.


We're growing quickly and looking for ambitious people who want to help build the company alongside us.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for a **Creative Operations Manager** to own staffing, capacity planning, and resource operations across our creative studio.


You'll work closely with Creative Producers, creative leads, and company leadership to make sure every project has the right team in place at the right time. You'll maintain a clear view across active and upcoming work, identify capacity constraints and scheduling conflicts, and help the studio make better staffing decisions as priorities shift.


A major part of this role is resource management, but you'll also help improve the systems and workflows behind how our studio operates. As we grow, you'll identify where our processes are breaking down and build better ways to plan, staff, track, and coordinate creative work.


This is a hands\-on role for someone who is exceptionally organized, proactive, and excited by both solving today's scheduling problems and building better systems for tomorrow.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Resource \& Capacity Management**

* Own resource planning across all active and upcoming creative projects
* Maintain a clear, up\-to\-date view of team availability, workload, project schedules, and upcoming capacity
* Identify capacity gaps, scheduling conflicts, and potential bottlenecks before they become problems
* Track utilization and help leadership understand where the team is over\- or under\-capacity
* Anticipate future resource needs based on the studio's pipeline and upcoming work

### **Project Staffing \& Scheduling**

* Match projects with the right internal team members based on skills, experience, availability, and project needs
* Partner with Creative Producers and creative leads to understand staffing needs and build the right project teams
* Support staffing for new business opportunities and incoming projects before work kicks off
* Manage staffing changes as project scopes, timelines, and priorities shift
* Coordinate internal staffing across shoots and maintain visibility into the studio\-wide shoot calendar

### **Creative Operations \& Systems**

* Build and maintain the systems, trackers, and dashboards used for resource and project planning
* Improve how projects are planned, staffed, kicked off, tracked, and handed off across the studio
* Identify recurring bottlenecks or operational issues and develop practical solutions
* Create clearer, more consistent processes for Creative Producers and creative teams
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work and reduce unnecessary coordination
* Help leadership understand the operational impact of upcoming work before commitments are made

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in creative operations, resource management, project coordination, creative production, or a related field
* Strong understanding of creative production workflows, including pre\-production, shoot execution, and post\-production
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail
* Naturally proactive — you see potential problems before someone has to point them out
* Strong people skills and the ability to build trust with creatives, project leads, and leadership
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities and constantly changing timelines
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Able to make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information
* Resourceful, persistent, and comfortable working without a rigid playbook
* Comfortable with spreadsheets, project management tools, and quick to learn new systems
* Naturally interested in finding better ways for teams to work

**Why Join Us**
---------------

* Play a central role in how a fast\-growing creative studio operates
* Work across a wide range of production projects for ambitious technology companies
* Help build the staffing, planning, and operational systems the company will use as it scales
* Work closely with Creative Producers, creative leadership, and company leadership
* Take ownership of an important function with visibility across the entire studio
* Remote\-friendly, flexible, and entrepreneurial environment
* Healthcare coverage, PTO, and company holidays

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Job summary  

Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer\-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data\-driven decisions and analytical problem\-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.  

  

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile \- where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile \- where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile \- when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.  

  

Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:  

* Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce
* Lead large\-scope projects with site and regional impact
* Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance
* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)


Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 1\+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
* Experience managing a team of 2\+ salaried employees and 70\+ indirect employees
* Experience scoping, leading, and implementing process improvements through: Lean process, Kaizen, and/or Six Sigma.
* Demonstrated problem solving skills and analytical skills
* Excellent customer service skills, communication skills and interpersonal skills
* Track record of meeting or exceeding department performance goals
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field.
* Experience in: military, manufacturing, automotive, biotech, electronics, energy, instrumentation, machinery, defense/aerospace, medical, cosmetics, production, or distribution environments.

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

  

USA, CA, Vacaville \- 91,000\.00 \- 136,500\.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**


HMC Architects is an employee\-owned design firm with an inherent desire to make a difference in our communities. As a purpose\-driven brand based on values, our mission to design for good drives everything we do. And our ownership culture creates alignment and increased commitment to that mission, keeping us on track to being successful.


**What We Do**


Founded with the purpose of anticipating community needs, HMC aims to create designs that have a positive impact, now and into the future. We focus primarily on opportunities to have the most direct contribution to communities–through healthcare, education, and civic spaces.


**Why Join HMC**


As an employee owned company you become an owner after one year—receiving company\-provided shares at no cost and building long\-term financial growth as the firm succeeds. We also give back through our volunteerism with our Designing Futures Foundation, which advances sustainable and regenerative design and supports the next generation of innovators. In addition to this, we also support our team through:


* **Culture**: We put people over profits, giving them the flexibility to manage their work and life. We believe in fairness, equality in opportunity, and rewarding those who perform.
* **Wellness**: company paid wellness courses, on\-site gyms (at select locations), access to financial advisors and discounts to wellness platforms, gyms and more.
* **Professional Development**: LinkedIn learning access, business development training, supportive mentorship, company\-paid ARE study materials, exam fees, and licensure completion bonuses.
* **Comprehensive Comp and Benefits**: Base\+Bonus\+Equity\+401k, including student loan repayments, wellness programs, full medical, dental, vision, time off and holidays above industry standard.

**Job Summary**


We are looking for an experienced **Project Manager** with Healthcare project experience. In this position you will lead all phases of medium to large projects from planning through construction. This role oversees budgeting, scheduling, design development, specifications, and construction documents, while maintaining strong client relationships and resolving architectural challenges. The Project Manager directs and monitors project activities and serves as primary client contact.


This position is located in HMC’s **San Jose, CA** office. The regular work schedule is Monday through Thursday 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. and Friday from 7:30 a.m. to 11:30 a.m., with a one\-hour lunch break. You will have the opportunity to work remote Mondays and Fridays.


**Responsibilities**


* Lead and manage all phases of architectural projects, including scope, schedule, budget, staffing, and billing
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, agencies, consultants, and stakeholders
* Supervise, mentor, and evaluate project team members; delegate work and provide performance feedback
* Prepare and manage work plans, schedules, staffing projections, and project fees
* Oversee design development, construction documents, specifications, and construction administration
* Ensure design intent, quality, code compliance, and coordination across all project deliverables
* Write and review project correspondence, RFIs, change orders, contracts, and meeting documentation
* Coordinate with agencies to resolve plan check and approval issues
* Review cost estimates, conduct value analysis, and manage project changes
* Participate in marketing efforts, proposals, and client interviews

**Requirements**


* Professional degree in Architecture from an accredited university or equivalent experience
* Minimum 7 years of experience in architectural practice, including project management
* Strong understanding of contractual obligations, project fees, and budget management
* Proven ability to lead teams, delegate effectively, and make sound decisions
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience managing consultants, agencies, and client relationships
* Ability to write and edit specifications and oversee construction documentation
* Highly organized, self\-directed, and capable of managing multiple priorities

The salary range for this position is $106,331 \- $164,965 annually.


The actual salary offered for this position will vary depending on multiple factors including the candidate’s qualification, education, position knowledge, work experience, skills, ability, work location, and internal incumbent compensation for similar roles. We do not anticipate individuals hired into this position will start at or near the top half of the range listed; the decision will be based on each individual case. The salary range listed above does not include other compensation elements such as discretionary bonus opportunities, employee stock ownership grants, paid time off, medical insurance, and other wage and benefit opportunities.

**Why Harvey**
==============


At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.


This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.


Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.


At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.


**Role Overview**
=================


The Senior Technical Program Manager, GTM Technology leads delivery of cross\-functional programs for Harvey's go\-to\-market systems. They join the program management team in Business Technology, Harvey's IT organization. This role ensures multi\-team GTM technology programs are well planned, coordinated across teams, and delivered on time. They work with GTM systems and integrations teams to deliver programs for Sales, Marketing, Product, and Finance. It is an opportunity to deliver high\-impact programs at an AI\-native company as an early member of a growing program management team.

* Own end\-to\-end delivery of Business Technology's most strategic lead\-to\-cash programs, from planning through launch and retrospective.
* Align cross\-functional program teams on scope, sequencing, and milestones for programs that span CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, and CPQ.
* Coordinate delivery across Business Technology's GTM systems and integrations teams to keep programs on plan.
* Surface risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs early, and drive them to decisions with the right owners.
* Give leadership clear visibility into program health through concise written updates, without adding overhead for delivery teams.
* Contribute to shared, AI\-enabled program practices that help the team deliver faster as Business Technology scales.

**What You Have**
=================


* 8\+ years of experience in technical program management or a related role, with a track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional GTM systems programs at high\-growth B2B SaaS companies.
* Experience leading at least one quote\-to\-cash, CRM, CPQ, or billing systems program end to end.
* Working knowledge of GTM systems such as Salesforce and how they connect, enough to understand trade\-offs and ask the right questions of systems teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Finance without direct authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to distill complex programs into clear narratives for executive audiences.
* Sound judgment on process and comfort with ambiguity. You right\-size structure to the program and default to simple, AI\-enabled ways of working.
